helper.name: Actor_ClearLinkedActorResources
helper.semantics: If the current actor has a linked record at +0x3E, clear that linked actor's type byte and release its owned resources through Actor_ClearOwnedResources; otherwise return without changing the current actor.

reachability: No direct static caller or runtime observation is currently recorded; the name describes the exact body and established actor-link contract without assigning a producer.
